global_caption: The video contains 4 shots. It is a multi-shot tutorial in cool-toned anime style, set on a rooftop in a cyberpunk neon city. The overall color palette is based on blue and purple cool tones, with primary lighting from neon ambient light and rim lighting on the subject. Camera movement is controlled, precise, and leans toward instructional presentation. There is no Only consistent The overall mood remains calm and focused.
shot1: Shot 1 opens directly into frame with a wide, eye-level, panning shot slowly gliding past the subject from the front-side, placing the figure slightly left of center. Behind is a deep urban skyline with glowing city lights and building silhouettes, with railings forming stable leading lines. Shallow to medium depth of field keeps the subject clearly defined against the neon background. Blue-purple ambient light evenly covers the rooftop surface and clothing, while rim lighting outlines the white hair and shoulders. An elderly man with white hair stands at the center of the rooftop, feet shoulder-width apart, toes naturally pointing forward with slight outward angle, arms relaxed at his sides. He makes a minor adjustment before settling firmly, centering his weight, opening his chest, maintaining neutral spine, establishing a clear starting position. At this point, The camera completes a smooth pan, establishing both environment and correct initial posture.
shot2: Shot 2 connects to the previous shot via hard cut to ensure clean transition of instructional content. A close-up, overhead, zoom-in shot focuses downward on the lower body and feet, framing the knee joints, toes, and ground markings. Foreground shows subtly glowing rooftop texture, focus locked tightly on leg alignment. Background neon is compressed into blurred color blocks. Cool neon continues as main illumination, with faint blue reflection on the ground. A layer of Chinese holographic guide lines appears along the outer legs and toe direction. Screen-style annotation text “膝尖与脚尖同向” appears in the bottom right corner, featuring semi-transparent electronic outline and subtle scanning animation. The lens slowly zooms in, enhancing visual clarity of alignment logic.
shot3: An extreme close-up, eye-level, slight tilt shot shifts to the side profile, focusing on torso, hips, and thigh positioning. Foreground includes slightly blurred railing lines; background features dimmed city neon. Depth of field is shallower, making motion details the sole visual focus. Lighting maintains blue-purple cool tone, with neon edge light highlighting facial and torso contours. Chest and abdominal lines and fabric wrinkles become clearly visible during movement. He begins demonstrating the squat: first contracting abdomen to stabilize core, then lifting chest to maintain neutral back, followed by hip retraction, knees bending in sync with toe direction, weight steadily centered over mid-foot, descent slow and discernible, thighs gradually approaching parallel to ground. No lumbar collapse, knee cave, or forward lean occurs. Clothing flaps slightly due to squatting motion. The camera performs a very slight tilt follow, emphasizing continuity of angular change from torso to hips to thighs.
shot4: Shot 4 connects to the previous shot via mild fade-in transition, giving the completion phase a stronger sense of closure. A medium shot, low angle, pulling back from directly below and in front of the subject, centers the figure with expansive flashing city lights and window glows behind. Lighting continues the cool neon theme, with pulsating blue-purple spots behind. Rim lighting enhances silhouette during the rising moment. He smoothly powers up from the lowest point of the standard squat, extending knees and hips simultaneously, maintaining torso stability, feet firmly planted without wobble, returning to original stance and completing one full, standardized squat correction demonstration. The end point forms a clear loop with the start.
